fnol_text: My name is Imogen Takahashi and I live at 32 Elmstead Court, Clinton, NC 28375. You can reach me on (555) 444-4497 or imogen.takahashi@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 6 September 2023, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2023-00153. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Dr Takahashi on (555) 444-4497 to acknowledge the claim. Imogen confirmed the loss date as 6 September 2023.
Site visit to 32 Elmstead Court. Neighbour Ravi Haddad was present and confirmed the timeline.
Imogen sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
